slug: 寒门医女别人练武我修仙
content_zh:
“驾~”
剧烈颠簸的马车中，被捆了手脚的花长曦睁开了双眼，一瞬的迷茫之后，面色变得又惊又惧。
她被绑架了！
今天，是花老太太带着花家女眷到京城南郊广济寺祈福的日子。
因不耐烦参加寺里的法会，花长曦独自溜出，本想看看广济寺后山那棵远近闻名的姻缘树的，谁知，刚到后山就脖子一疼，然后她就晕了过去。
早知道会遇到这么倒霉的事，她就是再坐不住，也会呆在家人身边的。
花长曦压下心慌，强迫自己冷静下来，快速打量起马车内部来。
马车内除了她，什么都没有，此时，她的双手被反绑在背后，双脚也被绑得死死的，动一下都十分吃力。
“砰砰砰~”
马车因疾驰而颠簸得厉害，车窗不断的发出撞击声。
花长曦看着不断开合的车窗，双眼一亮，费力的扭动身子，艰难的将捆绑着的双腿抬起来搭在车壁上，整个人呈L形仰躺在马车里。
之后，花长曦又将双脚伸到车窗上，右脚沿着窗沿来回磨蹭，将脚上的鞋蹭出马车。
闭眼休息了一会儿，预估着马车又驶出五公里，花长曦再次磨脚，将另一只鞋也蹭掉了出去。
她爹是六扇门捕快，家里发现她丢失了，肯定会来找她的，希望这两只鞋能够为她爹提供线索。
花长曦思索了一下，担心两只鞋不够，又背靠车壁挣扎着弯腰站起，用反绑着的手拽下腰间的荷包，将荷包扔出了车窗。
“吁~”
感觉马车在减速，花长曦快速躺下，闭上眼睛，装作还没醒来。
没一会儿，“咯吱”一声，马车车门打开了。
接着，花长曦感觉自己像死狗一样，被绑匪拽着胳膊拖了出去，接着又像沙包一样，被人扛在了肩上。
“为了抓这一个，咱们可是耽搁了不短的时间，今天是最后的期限，我之前还担心咱们交不了差呢。”

听着两绑匪的对话，花长曦的心顿时跌入谷底。
她原以为自己是被随机绑架的，没曾想绑匪就是冲着她来的！
可是原因呢？
劫财？
京城有的是富商，花家连个仆人都用不上，绑她根本没有银子赚。
劫色？
她才十三岁，脸没完全长开，身体也没发育好，即便卖到青楼都得再养两年。
难道是花家的仇家报复？
她爹作为六扇门捕快，平日里没少和三教九流的人打交道，期间肯定有结仇生怨的，这个可能性最大。
被人扛在肩上，脑袋朝下，花长曦料想两人不会注意她，便飞快的睁眼看了一下绑匪带她来的地方。
一座坍塌了大半的破庙！
“我们手上这个是最后一个了吧？”
“嗯。”
说话间，两个绑匪已经扛着花长曦走进了破庙。
“咔嚓~”
摩擦声响起。
花长曦再次飞快的睁眼看了看。
只见另一个绑匪站在破庙中央那座坏得只剩下一点底座的神像前，双手抱着底座上的一个凸起在转动。
下一刻，神像缓缓移开，一个地道口露了出来。
“走吧！”

绑匪扛着花长曦跳下了地道。
地底下，地道交错纵横，石室很多。
花长曦努力的想要记住所走的路线，可惜，被人扛着，脑袋充血发胀，不仅思考受阻，就连视线也严重受限。
原本还指着记住路线后以备之后逃跑，可现在她连地道里的情况都看不清。
上腹被顶得难受，花长曦突然灵机一动，‘呕’了几声。
content_en:
"Drive~"
In the violently bumpy carriage, Hua Changxi, whose hands and feet were tied, opened her eyes. After a moment of confusion, her expression became frightened and frightened.
She's been kidnapped!
Today is the day when Mrs. Hua and her female relatives go to Guangji Temple in the southern suburbs of the capital to pray for blessings.
Because she was impatient to attend the Dharma assembly in the temple, Hua Changxi slipped out alone. She wanted to see the famous marriage tree in the back hill of Guangji Temple. Unexpectedly, she felt a pain in her neck as soon as she arrived at the back hill, and then she fainted.
If she had known that something like this would happen to her, she would have stayed with her family no matter how hard she sat still.
Hua Changxi suppressed her panic, forced herself to calm down, and quickly looked inside the carriage.
There was nothing in the carriage but her. At this time, her hands were tied behind her back and her feet were tied so tightly that it was very difficult to move.
"Bang bang bang~"
The carriage was jolting violently due to the speed, and the windows kept banging.
Hua Changxi's eyes lit up as she looked at the constantly opening and closing windows. She twisted her body with difficulty, raised her bound legs with difficulty and put them on the car wall, lying on her back in the carriage in an L shape.
After that, Hua Changxi stretched her feet to the car window, rubbed her right foot back and forth along the window edge, and rubbed her shoes out of the carriage.
After closing her eyes and resting for a while, expecting the carriage to drive another five kilometers, Hua Changxi rubbed her feet again and knocked off her other shoe.
Her father is a six-door policeman. If the family finds that she is missing, they will definitely come looking for her. I hope these two shoes can provide clues to her father.
Hua Changxi thought for a while, worried that the two shoes were not enough, so she leaned against the car wall and struggled to stand up. She pulled the purse from her waist with her hands tied behind her back and threw the purse out of the car window.
"Xu~"
Feeling that the carriage was slowing down, Hua Changxi quickly lay down, closed her eyes, and pretended not to wake up.
After a while, there was a "creak" and the carriage door opened.
Then, Hua Changxi felt like a dead dog being dragged out by the kidnappers' arms, and then was carried on his shoulders like a sandbag.
"We have been delayed for a long time in order to catch this one. Today is the deadline. I was worried that we wouldn't be able to meet the deadline."
Listening to the conversation between the two kidnappers, Hua Changxi's heart suddenly hit rock bottom.
She originally thought she was kidnapped randomly, but she never thought that the kidnapper was coming for her!
But what's the reason?
Robbery?
There were many wealthy businessmen in the capital, and the Hua family didn't even need a servant. There was no money to be made from tying her up.
Robbery?
She is only thirteen years old, her face is not fully grown, and her body is not well developed. Even if she is sold to a brothel, she will have to be raised for another two years.
Could it be revenge from the enemies of the Hua family?
As a six-door police agent, her father usually dealt with people from all walks of life. There must have been enemies and grudges during this period. This was the most likely possibility.
Being carried on someone's shoulders with her head facing down, Hua Changxi expected that the two would not pay attention to her, so she quickly opened her eyes and looked at the place where the kidnapper took her.
A ruined temple with most of it collapsed!
"Is this the last one we have?"
"Yeah."
While they were talking, the two kidnappers had already walked into the ruined temple carrying Hua Changxi.
"Click~"
There was a grinding sound.
Hua Changxi quickly opened her eyes and took a look again.
I saw another kidnapper standing in front of the statue in the center of the ruined temple that was so damaged that only a little of the base was left, holding a protrusion on the base with both hands and turning it.
The next moment, the statue slowly moved away, and a tunnel entrance was revealed.
"Let's go!"
The kidnapper jumped out of the tunnel carrying Hua Changxi.
Underground, tunnels are criss-crossed and there are many stone chambers.
Hua Changxi tried hard to remember the route she took, but unfortunately, she was being carried, and her head was congested and swollen. Not only was her thinking blocked, but her vision was also severely limited.
Originally, she was planning to memorize the route in case she could escape later, but now she couldn't even see clearly what was going on in the tunnel.
The pain in her upper abdomen was so painful that Hua Changxi suddenly had an idea and made a few 'vomit' sounds.
